findings.title: Model router call log file is missing

evidence.observation: Model router call log file does not exist at expected path (/opt/starship-endeavour/core/model-router/call_log.jsonl)

proposed_action.description: Ensure the model router service creates and writes to the configured call log file destination to maintain auditability of LLM calls

findings.expected_benefit: Restores visibility and telemetry tracking for LLM routing, latency metrics, and failure rates

findings.title: Unimplemented Phase 5 features in platform-runtime research command

evidence.observation: Multiple TODO comments indicate missing implementation for Phase 5 authorization and decision_to_memory integration

proposed_action.description: Implement Supabase authorization checking and decision_to_memory integration or document implementation tracking

findings.expected_benefit: Completes research command security and persistence capabilities

findings.title: Quality forecasting service contains stubbed query anomaly logic

evidence.observation: TODO marker indicating recent_anomalies is hardcoded as an empty list instead of querying quality_anomalies table

proposed_action.description: Implement the query against the quality_anomalies table to populate recent_anomalies

findings.expected_benefit: Enables accurate quality anomaly forecasting rather than relying on an empty stub

findings.title: Emergency alerts directly invoke external LLM providers rather than model router

evidence.observation: Direct calls to call_gemini and call_mistral via API keys bypass the model router

proposed_action.description: Route emergency alert LLM invocations through the central model router endpoint

findings.expected_benefit: Centralises routing policies, fallback logic, rate-limit management, and logging for emergency alert summarisation
